Convene **UX & Accessibility** (lead, Surface layer — **hard veto** on WCAG 2.2 AA and state completeness), **UX Researcher/IA** (structure, IA, flows — **UX-specification veto**), **Product Strategist** (job-to-be-done), the relevant platform developer (Mobile / Native Desktop / web language dev), **The Simplifier** (soft veto; delete-list with `net: -N`), and **Domain Researcher** for platform guidelines and comparables. Add the **AI Systems Engineer** if the surface fronts a model **or if any asset is generated** (non-determinism, eval, inference cost), the **Privacy & Data Governance** lens if generation touches likeness or personal data (**hard veto**, VA9), the **Test Architect** for falsifiable UI criteria, and the **SRE** for the performance budget and layout stability.

**Ground first** in `docs/specs/` Parts B and C, `DESIGN.md`, `docs/mockups/`, `docs/design/`, the real components (**open the files — never describe them from memory**, `end-to-end-integrity.md` E15), and the UX-* classes in `docs/lessons/defect-classes.md`. A settled UI over an unsettled UX layer is a **BLOCK** (S2) — run `/specify` for Part B first.

**State the mode: create · review · elevate.** If the surface already exists, default to **review** before rebuilding.

**Map the triggered standards NOW, at Stage 1, not at the gate.** Modes are mutually exclusive; these are **orthogonal and composable**, applied as a **union** with Testing-Strategy force (`testing-strategy.md` §3): a triggered-but-unmet directive is a gap the gate catches, never a nicety to skip. Walk every row and **state which fire and which do not, with the reason** — they reshape Stage 1 itself, so a trigger found in the definition of done has already cost you the archetype decision it should have informed.
- *Unconditional (every run):* `ui-interaction-design.md` U1–U20, `ui-design-craft.md` DX1–DX25, `ui-craft-detection.md` CD1–CD20, and `specification-standards.md` S2/S7 (an unsettled UX layer is a **BLOCK**).
- **UI-T1 — expert working with quantities** (CAD, scientific/engineering viz, notebooks, spreadsheet/financial modeling, simulation and risk, quant terminals) → **`technical-ui-design.md`** TQ1–TQ12. Archetype comes from catalog **§G (G1–G6)**, not A–F. Perceptually-uniform colormap with legend (**never jet/rainbow**), tabular unit-bearing numerics at consistent precision, **uncertainty-first** output, direct-manipulation *and* precision input, provenance, reactive recompute, large-data performance. A rainbow colormap, a unit-less quantity, or a point estimate for a stochastic result is a **correctness** defect, not taste.
- **UI-T2 — generated imagery, persona or motion** → **`ui-visual-assets.md`** VA1–VA22. Visual world after the words and before the design language; mood never structure (VA6); supplements never replaces real named references (VA7); **never generate the interface itself** (VA5); assets committed with manifest, alt text and disclosure (VA4, VA12–VA13). Convenes **AI Systems Engineer** and **Privacy & Data Governance** (both hard vetoes).
- **UI-T3 — the surface fronts a model** → **U13–U15** (HAX + Shape-of-AI), plus **U15a** if usage is metered. The **wrong answer and uncertainty are enumerated as first-class states** alongside empty/loading/error; name the HAX guidelines and the Shape-of-AI patterns; oversight precedes any consequential action.
- **UI-T4 — native client app** (first slice: **WPF, WinUI, Avalonia, Blazor Hybrid**) → declare medium/platform/framework/distribution/accessibility API; cite the platform HIG; use `templates/native-ui-proof-pack.template.md`; run native proof for keyboard, accessibility tree, theme/high-contrast, DPI/windowing, OS integration, performance and signing/SmartScreen/notarization where applicable; run `xaml-token-lint.py` on WPF/WinUI/Avalonia shell markup. HTML mockups and static craft scans are direction evidence only — they cannot clear native PASS.

A trigger is a claim about the surface, so establish it rather than assume it; when genuinely borderline, take the higher tier.

**Interdict the rush: do NOT generate a screen yet** (and in review mode, do not diagnose before you measure).

**OPEN — direction in words (DX5).** Write the direction brief: user + the emotional state they arrive in; the job-to-be-done; the **Archetype Signature** chosen *from* that JTBD (nearest catalog row, deviations noted); **three defining adjectives and their opposites**; **named references with what specifically is taken from each** (adapt, never clone); anti-goals; constraints (medium + platform HIG, density, brand assets, a11y obligation). Decide personality in **type / color / space**, each with a one-line justification. **Verify the archetype against the shape of the task, including on existing screens** — reading is parallel, entering is serial. *Optionally then* make the direction concrete with a **visual world** — 2–4 generated candidate boards, chosen by the human, recorded in `DESIGN.md` with verbatim prompt/model/preset (VA15). Hard limits: mood **never** structure (VA6), supplements **never** replaces real named references (VA7), and **never generate the interface itself** — no screenshots, panels, charts or icon sets, because image models render illegible text and invented controls (VA5).

**INTERROGATE.** What is this surface for and explicitly not for; what do we assume about device/expertise/data volume/arrival state; what does this archetype force and forbid; is this the established pattern for the job (Jakob's Law) or an invention; which single decision most determines success. Enumerate the **surface inventory** — every screen/component and its full state set (default/hover/focus/active/disabled/**loading**/**empty**/**error**/success/**overflow**).

**EVIDENCE.** *Measure before diagnosing* (DX23): count interactive controls, simultaneous sections, load-time network calls, competing focal points, distinct type sizes, distinct colors, and modes that do the same job. Run **both linters — they check opposite directions of the same contract** (CD5): `python3 docs/ai-forward-pack/scripts/design-lint.py <DESIGN.md> --strict` **inward** (does every `{token}` reference resolve?) and `python3 docs/ai-forward-pack/scripts/ui-craft-gate.py <surface> --markdown` **outward** — the deterministic 59-rule detector, which reads your `DESIGN.md` natively and reports every off-token color/font/size/radius in the *built* source plus the mechanized tells, hierarchy, motion, copy and overflow rules; its measurement block **is** the DX23 count. Confirm it scanned a **non-empty corpus** — a detector that matched no files exits clean and proves nothing (CD9). Compute contrast for every text/surface pairing. Establish platform guidelines and comparables from sources (label Verified/Inferred/Flagged). **Build the system before the screens (DX2):** produce/update `DESIGN.md` from `templates/design-language.template.md` — token frontmatter, **token-layer contrast audit**, complete state matrix, theme/density modes, paired Archetype Signature, motion + reduced-motion, real copy strings, performance budget, HAX/Shape-of-AI rules, **and the `assets:` manifest for any generated imagery** (VA12) — lint-clean, preview rendered. Write the **motion inventory** and draft the **real in-voice UI copy**.

**DISCONFIRM (the gate).** Run the critique rubric **structure before surface** (DX24): archetype fit and flow/IA → state completeness → accessibility → craft. Every finding carries **location · dimension · severity 0–4 · evidence · fix · confidence**, mapped to **[Blocker|Major|Minor|Nit]** (a11y ≥3 is a Blocker under U16). **Fold in the detector's translated findings** with the CD12 severity floors applied — accessibility findings Major minimum (Blocker under an obligation), token-discipline findings Major minimum — and remember what it cannot see (CD14): archetype fit, IA, whether the hard states exist **at all**, whether the copy is true, whether the focal point is defended. **A clean detector run is a floor, never a verdict** (CD13); any suppressed rule carries a real reason and a standing suppression is a recorded deviation (CD16). Self-check the **generic-tells table** (DX3) — violet gradient, uniform cards, three equal stat tiles, uniform spacing, lorem, emoji icons, happy-only states, symmetric everything, motion on everything, plus the **imagery tells** for generated assets (VA8: teal-and-orange grading, glossy skin, impossible bokeh, stock-mimicry): each absent or a justified deliberate choice. Exercise the mockup harness across every persona, viewport, state, theme and the reduced-motion path. **UX & Accessibility states PASS/BLOCK with its veto-clears-when predicate, and the author does not clear it.**

**CONVERGE.** Produce: a **self-contained, dependency-free HTML mockup** at `docs/mockups/<surface>.html` (no build, no CDN, opens over `file://`) rendering **empty / loading / error / partial / overflow** with realistic extreme content, shipping the **review harness** (persona · viewport · state · theme/density · capability flags · reduced motion) plus in-artifact contrast/target checks — start from `templates/mockup-harness.template.html`; its graph hub node `docs/mockups/<surface>.md`; the updated `DESIGN.md`; **any generated assets downloaded, optimized and committed under `docs/assets/<surface>/`** with their manifest entries, alt text and disclosure (VA4, VA12–VA14) — never a provider CDN URL, which expires in 7 days; (the template's audit asserts a NON-ZERO page box before any number - a gating selector on <body> hid a whole page while every figure still computed, DC-200), and in review/elevate mode `docs/reviews/ui-<surface>.md` from `templates/ui-review.template.md` with the measurements (every oracle string QUOTED from DESIGN.md's *Copy added by this section* row, never retyped - DC-196), the scorecard, and a **ranked plan (must-fix / should-fix-next / worth-doing) naming the single highest improvement-to-effort change**. End with the status table (Completed | Remaining | Best next action).

**Last action — discoverability (V10, `knowledge/knowledge-visualization.md`):** write each artifact's **frontmatter** (id, type, status, owner, typed links, review-by, real summary — the mockup's `.md` hub is the node, the `.html` is data) and sync the derived index via the **script bundle** `python3 docs/ai-forward-pack/scripts/docs-graph.py derive` (`flag` for V16) — no ad-hoc scripts (V18); ensure `docs/index.html` exists; verify no orphans; a changed archetype/token system/UI contract is **material** — flag inbound neighbours `review-suggested`; capture direction decisions as **decision notes** in `docs/notes/` (V17); and register any UI defect found or created as a **class** with its control in `docs/lessons/defect-classes.md` (`knowledge/continuous-improvement.md` CI1).

**Running this in Copilot (single agent — make the dialog visible).** Copilot does not auto-spawn the personas as separate subagents the way Claude Code does, so enact the round-table *inline*: for each peer write a short labeled contribution in that persona's voice (e.g. **UX Researcher/IA —** …); then run the adversary round, each reviewer giving a labeled critique with a severity **[Blocker|Major|Minor|Nit]** and, for hard-veto roles, an explicit **PASS/BLOCK** plus the veto-clears-when predicate (`persona-cards.md` §8). Do not collapse this into one unattributed answer — the critique dialog is the deliverable.

**Audit (last action):** `python3 docs/ai-forward-pack/scripts/audit-log.py append --shortname "ui-design-<surface>" --session "<id>" --skill ui-design --kind skill --prompt "<verbatim>" --summary "<produced/found>" --artifact docs/mockups/<surface>.html` (Audit Mandate, AL5); add a change-log entry when a direction or archetype decision was settled (CL1).
